mapping.invalid: This choice of columns is not possible: the full name is required and a column serves one field only.

preview.title: Row by row preview
preview.loadFailed: The rows could not be read. Try again in a moment.
preview.scroll: Preview of the rows of the file

reason.duplicate_identifier_in_file: Duplicate: identifier already in the file
reason.duplicate_email_in_file: Duplicate: email already in the file

rest.one: The other row will not be imported; you can correct it in the error file.
rest.other: The other {count} rows will not be imported; you can correct them in the error file.

confirm.nothing: No row is ready to import. Correct the file or the columns.

progress.title: Import under way
progress.text: The voters are written in the background. You can leave the page: the import goes on.
progress.label: Import progress

done.title: Import finished
done.text: The voters are in the election, placed in their groups.

background.title: The import runs in the background
background.text: A progress bar shows how far it is; you can leave the page.

codes.title: Codes come after
codes.text: The import creates no code. You generate them in the “Codes” step.

codes.title: Access codes

lost.title: Lost slip
lost.text: Look the voter up by name. A new code is created and shown only once; the old slip, if there is one, stops working.
lost.typeName: Type at least one letter of the name.
lost.more: Only the first results are shown: be more precise.
lost.once: This code is shown only once. Print or download the slip before closing.
lost.replaced: This voter’s old slip no longer works.
lost.first: This is this voter’s first code.
lost.downloadFailed: The slip could not be downloaded.
lost.emailQueued: The new code was queued to be sent by email.

codes.locked: Codes can no longer be created or replaced: the election is over. Slip files are deleted when it closes.

run.status: Generating. Files appear as soon as they are ready; you can stay on this page.

failed.one: {count} file failed: its voters have no code. Run the generation again for that group.
failed.other: {count} files failed: their voters have no code. Run the generation again for those groups.

result.codeFileFailed: The distribution file could not be written. The codes are issued and the printed slips are ready: run the file again with a new send.

group.downloadFailed: The file could not be downloaded.

empty.title: No voter yet
empty.text: Add or import voters before creating their codes.

codes.loadFailed: The state of the codes could not be read.
codes.note: A code cannot be shown again: only its fingerprint is kept. A lost slip is replaced by a new code, unless the voter has already voted.

send.title: Generate and send the codes
send.text: Choose the voters, then how they receive their code. Nothing is done before you confirm.
send.emailHelp: Each voter who has an address receives their personal link and code.
send.nothing: No code to create for these voters.
send.nobody: None of these voters has an address: no email can be sent.

noEmailTitle.one: {count} voter with no address, left for print
noEmailTitle.other: {count} voters with no address, left for print

send.noEmailPrint: Their slip is in the PDF file of their group.
send.readFailed: The numbers could not be read.
send.changed: The number of emails changed since you read it. Check the new numbers, then confirm again.

files.title: Distribution files
files.text: The file holds the codes in clear: keep it safe. It is deleted when the election closes.

code.heading: Enter your code
code.lede: Your personal code is on your slip. It has ten characters.
code.label: Your voting code
code.help: Upper or lower case, with or without the hyphen.
code.step1Text: Enter the code from your slip.
code.step2Text: Check that it is really you.
code.step3Text: Choose on each position, review, then confirm.
code.secretText: No one can link your name to your choices. A vote can be confirmed only once.

notice.expired: Your session has ended. Enter your code again to continue.
notice.ended: Session ended. The next voter can enter their code.
notice.alreadyVoted: This code has already been used: the vote is recorded and cannot be changed.

error.invalid_code: This code is not valid. Check it on your slip, or ask for a new one.
error.already_voted: This code has already been used: the vote is recorded and cannot be changed.
error.voter_session_expired: Your session has ended. Enter your code again.
error.choices_invalid: One of your choices is no longer valid. Start the vote again.
error.ballots_mismatch: The positions that concern you have changed. Start the vote again.

before.heading: Your election is not open yet
before.text: Everything is ready on our side. The code field will appear here as soon as voting opens, with no need to reload the page.
before.soon: Opening is imminent, the page updates by itself.
before.countdown: Opens in {days} d {hours} h {minutes} min {seconds} s
before.step1Text: It is on your slip or in your personal link.
before.step2Text: The field appears when voting opens.
before.step3Text: One candidate per position, or a blank vote if you prefer.
before.step4Text: Review your choices, then confirm: you are done.
before.secretText: No one will be able to link your name to your choices, not even the organiser.
before.readyText: Keep your slip or your personal link ready. This page updates by itself: you can leave it open.

closed.heading: Voting has ended
closed.text: This election is closed: it is no longer possible to vote.

identity.noneText: You have nothing to vote on in this election. Please ask the organisers.
identity.hint: If this is not you, do not continue: give the place back to the right person.

ballot.full: You have chosen the maximum. Remove a choice to change it.

review.heading: Review your vote
review.lede: Check each choice. Once confirmed, it cannot be changed.
review.warning: Your vote is secret and final.

done.heading: Your vote is recorded
done.text: Thank you for voting. Your choice is secret and can no longer be changed.
done.countdown: Back to code entry in {seconds} s
done.secretText: The organisers will publish the results after voting closes.

unavailable.title: This election is not available
unavailable.text: The address you opened does not lead to a vote at the moment.
unavailable.checkText: Open the link you received again, or copy it in full.
unavailable.askText: They can confirm the address and the date of the vote.
unavailable.homeText: You can also start again from the home page.
unavailable.secure: No vote has been recorded here.

turnout.title: Turnout
turnout.notStarted: Voting has not started yet: nobody could vote.
turnout.final: Voting is over: these figures are final.
turnout.secrecy: Votes stay hidden until the election is closed, for everyone.
turnout.loadFailed: The figures could not be refreshed.

chart.title: Votes over time
chart.empty: Nobody has voted yet. The curve will appear with the first vote.

label.one: Turnout curve, by {unit}: {total} voter has voted in all, {last} in the latest period ({at}).
label.other: Turnout curve, by {unit}: {total} voters have voted in all, {last} in the latest period ({at}).

chart.labelEmpty: Turnout curve: nobody has voted yet.

groups.title: By group
groups.hint: Click a group to see who has not voted.
groups.empty: No group: the voters are not split up.

nonvoters.title: Who has not voted
nonvoters.exportFailed: The export could not be made.
nonvoters.none: No voter is registered for this election.

empty.title: No voters yet
empty.text: Add voters to follow the turnout.

results.title: Results

unavailable.title: The results are not available yet

text.open: Voting is in progress. No result is visible, for anyone, until the election is closed.
text.other: Results appear only after the election is closed. No result is visible, for anyone, before then.

tie.title: Tie

text.one: {names} are tied for the last seat ({seats} seat left to fill).
text.other: {names} are tied for the last seats ({seats} seats left to fill).

tie.never: The system never breaks a tie: no winner is named for these seats. You can organise a second round.

check.badHelp: The number of ballots does not match the voters who voted: look into it before publishing.

note.label: Public note for this position
note.help: Shown with the result on the public page. Leave empty to show nothing.
note.tooLong: The note cannot be longer than {max} characters.

second.title: Organise a second round
second.text: The position “{ballot}” is tied between {names}. A new draft election will be created.

points.only: It holds only this position and the tied candidates.
points.voters: It has the same voters and the same groups.
points.codes: New codes must be generated before it can be scheduled.

second.created: A second round was created for this position.
second.notTied: This position is not tied: no second round is possible.

rail.label: Guide

legendItems.winner: Elected: the candidate wins a seat.
legendItems.tie: Tie: the system never breaks a tie; a second round can be organised.
legendItems.blank: Blank vote: a ballot with no choice, counted in the total.
legendItems.percent: Percentage: votes over all the ballots of the position, blank included.

rail.secrecy: Results are counted from the ballots only: nothing links them to a voter.

results.refreshError: The results could not be read again. Reload the page to see the current state.

status.closed: The results are ready. They stay private until you publish them.
status.published: The results are public: anyone with the link can see them, without an account.
status.archived: The election is archived. Its public page is no longer visible.

publish.title: Publish the results?
publish.text: The page “{title}” will be visible to anyone who has its address, without an account. You can take it down at any time.
publish.fullHelp: Votes and percentages of every candidate, blank votes, winners and turnout.
publish.winnersHelp: The winners, the tied candidates and the turnout. No vote counts.

smallGroup.one: The ballot “{ballots}” has fewer than 3 voters: one person’s choice can be guessed from the published results.
smallGroup.other: The ballots “{ballots}” have fewer than 3 voters: one person’s choice can be guessed from the published results.

unpublish.title: Take the public page down?
unpublish.text: The public page disappears at once. The results stay here and you can publish them again.

archive.help: Archiving also takes the public page down.

report.error: The report could not be downloaded.

institution.empty: This institution has not published any results yet.
institution.emptyHelp: Results will appear here as soon as an election is published.

public.winnersOnly: This page shows the winners and the turnout. Vote counts are not published.

ballot.none: No candidate is elected on this ballot.

tie.title: Tie

text.one: {names} are tied for the last seat ({seats} seat to fill).
text.other: {names} are tied for the last seats ({seats} seats to fill).

tie.never: The system never breaks a tie: no winner is named for these seats.

share.title: Share these results
share.text: Send the link to this page, or download the report and the image to attach.
share.copyFailed: Copying did not work: select the address below.

closing.title: More results from {name}
closing.line: Find the elections this institution has published.

unavailable.title: No public results here
unavailable.text: This address leads to no published results. An election’s results only appear once the institution has published them.
unavailable.secure: No result is visible before publication.
